# Chapter 5 — Autonomous Agents

Source: https://natureofcode.com/autonomous-agents/

Key concepts: steering behaviors (seek, flee, arrive, wander), flow fields, path following, group behaviors (separation, alignment, cohesion), flocking (Reynolds).

Seeds:
- Autonomous agents chapter implements steering forces for goal-directed motion.
- Seek, arrive, wander and flow fields give agents purposeful movement.
- Flocking combines separation, alignment and cohesion into group behavior.
